cached_extraction.description:
Data Analyst Intern
Lakeside Analytics — Houston, TX (Hybrid)

About the role

Lakeside Analytics helps regional operations teams understand their data. We are looking for a Data Analyst Intern to join our reporting team for a paid internship. You will work alongside two senior analysts on recurring reporting, data cleaning, and dashboard development. This is a hands-on role for a student who enjoys turning messy spreadsheets into something a business partner can actually use.

What you will do

- Prepare recurring weekly reporting for the analytics team, including refreshing source extracts and checking totals against prior periods.
- Clean and validate survey and operational data before analysis, documenting any assumptions you make.
- Build and maintain Power BI dashboards used by business partners across operations and finance.
- Produce clear data visualization that a non-technical reader can interpret without a walkthrough.
- Write SQL queries against our reporting warehouse to answer ad hoc questions.
- Use Python and pandas for repeatable data cleaning steps rather than manual edits.
- Document data definitions so that reports stay consistent from week to week.

Minimum qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in information systems, statistics, business analytics, economics, or a related field.
- Working knowledge of SQL, including joins and aggregation.
- Comfort with Excel, including pivot tables and lookup functions.
- Some exposure to Python for data analysis.
- Working knowledge of Power BI for building and publishing reports.
- Clear written communication; you will be asked to explain your numbers.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building dashboards in Tableau or a similar tool.
- Coursework in statistics or research methods.
- Experience working with survey data.

What we offer

A paid internship, a hybrid schedule with two days per week in our Houston office, and a mentor from the analytics team. We review interns for full-time consideration at the end of the term.

Lakeside Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.

cached_extraction.description:
Junior Data Analyst
Bayou Insights — Houston, TX (Hybrid)

Who we are

Bayou Insights is a small analytics consultancy serving logistics and energy services clients along the Gulf Coast. Our analysts sit close to the business, and the reporting we produce is read by people who make operational decisions the same week.

The role

We are hiring a Junior Data Analyst to own recurring reporting and to improve how our data visualization work is delivered. You will spend most of your week in SQL and Power BI, with Excel used for quick reconciliation and client-facing summaries. This role suits someone early in their career who wants to be trusted with a reporting stream rather than handed fragments of one.

Responsibilities

- Produce recurring operational reporting for internal stakeholders and for two client accounts.
- Build data visualization that non-technical partners can read quickly, and retire dashboards nobody uses.
- Clean and reconcile data arriving from several source systems, and flag quality problems early.
- Support ad hoc analysis requests from the operations team, usually with a same-day turnaround.
- Write short written summaries of what the numbers mean, not just what they are.

Required qualifications

- At least one year of related analytical experience, including internships and substantial academic project work.
- Working SQL skills: joins, aggregation, and window functions.
- Demonstrated Power BI experience, including building and publishing reports.
- Strong Excel skills for reconciliation and summary work.
- Experience producing data visualization for a non-technical audience.
- A bachelor's degree in progress or completed in a quantitative or business field.

Preferred qualifications

- Python for data cleaning and automation.
- Coursework or applied work in statistics.
- Exposure to consulting or client-facing analytics.

Details

Hybrid schedule, three days per week in our Houston office. Bayou Insights is an equal opportunity employer.

cached_extraction.description:
Business Intelligence Intern
Gulf Coast Retail Group — Houston, TX (On-site)

Overview

Gulf Coast Retail Group operates regional grocery and convenience locations across southeast Texas. Our business intelligence team supports merchandising, supply chain, and store operations with reporting that people actually use on the floor.

What you will do

- Support merchandising analytics with recurring weekly and monthly reporting.
- Assist with dashboard development and testing before reports are published to category managers.
- Produce data visualization that a category manager can read in under a minute.
- Prepare data extracts and support data cleaning across several source feeds, and answer questions about how a number was derived.
- Help maintain our reporting documentation so definitions stay stable across teams.
- Participate in a weekly analytics review where interns present one finding.

Minimum qualifications

- Enrolled in a bachelor's program in business, information systems, supply chain, statistics, or a related field.
- Comfort with Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and basic charting.
- Introductory SQL: you can read a query and modify a filter.
- Coursework or applied exposure to statistics.
- Attention to detail and willingness to check your own work.

Preferred qualifications

- Exposure to Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. Our published reports are built in Power BI, and candidates who have used any modern visualization tool pick it up quickly.
- Familiarity with ETL concepts, such as how a nightly load can change yesterday's numbers.
- Retail, grocery, or supply chain coursework or work experience.
- Interest in merchandising analytics.

Schedule

On-site in Houston, twenty to twenty-five hours per week during the academic term. Gulf Coast Retail Group is an equal opportunity employer.

cached_extraction.description:
Entry Level Data Analyst
Harbor Logistics Co — Remote (United States)

About the team

Harbor Logistics Co moves freight for mid-market shippers, and our analytics team is how the operations group knows what happened yesterday and what is likely to happen tomorrow. We are a small team, so new analysts get real ownership quickly.

Responsibilities

- Maintain daily and weekly shipment reporting, including on-time performance and exception summaries.
- Investigate data quality issues across carrier feeds, and work with the integrations team when a feed drifts.
- Summarize findings for operations leadership in plain language, with the caveats stated honestly.
- Write and maintain SQL queries used by recurring reports.
- Apply basic statistics to distinguish a real change from normal week-to-week variation.

Minimum qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field.
- Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and formulas across multiple sheets.
- Working SQL knowledge with the ability to write joins and aggregations.
- Familiarity with basic statistics such as averages, distributions, and variation.
- Clear written communication.

Preferred qualifications

- Python for repeatable data cleaning.
- Experience building dashboards in Tableau.
- Logistics, supply chain, or transportation exposure.

Work setup

Fully remote within the United States, with quarterly optional travel. Harbor Logistics Co is an equal opportunity employer.

Data Analyst Intern
Northline Energy Services — Houston, TX (On-site)

Position summary

Northline Energy Services provides field services to operators across Texas and Louisiana. The data team supports production reporting, field operations, and safety analytics. We are hiring a Data Analyst Intern for the coming term.

Key responsibilities

- Assist with production and operations reporting on a weekly cycle.
- Clean field data before it reaches the reporting layer, including handling missing entries and duplicate records.
- Prepare summary charts for weekly review meetings with field supervisors.
- Support the analytics team with ad hoc data pulls and simple analysis.
- Keep a written record of the steps used to produce each recurring report.

Required qualifications

- Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in engineering, information systems, statistics, or a related field.
- Working knowledge of Excel, including formulas and pivot tables.
- Some experience with Python for data cleaning or analysis coursework.
- Willingness to ask questions when a data point does not look right.

Preferred qualifications

- SQL familiarity.
- Exposure to Tableau or another visualization tool.
- Interest in energy operations.

Details

On-site in Houston, part-time during the academic term with the option of full-time hours during the summer. Northline Energy Services is an equal opportunity employer.
